import sys, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from te.algorithms.sub_algorithms import simplex_projection as SP, pgd
from te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.admm import ADMMWrapper
from te.algorithms.communication.partial_barrier import PartialBarrier
from te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.worker import DenseSolver
from te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.coordinator import Coordinator
from te.path_providers.base import PathProvider
H=np.eye(6)+0.1
proj=lambda v,pinned,mass,active: SP.project_onto_probability_orthant(v.reshape(3,2),pinned,mass,active).ravel()
out=pgd.do_path_based_nesterov_pgd(np.zeros(6),H,np.array([1.,0,0,0,1.,0]),np.array([1.0,2.0]),np.ones((3,2),bool),1.0,200,proj,None,0)
print('pgd',np.round(out,4).tolist())
print('resid', pgd.incomplete_gradient_norm(np.zeros(6),H,np.ones(6),proj,np.array([1.,2.]),np.ones((3,2),bool)))
for kw in [dict(),dict(alpha=1.5),dict(nesterov=True),dict(alpha=1.5,nesterov=True)]:
    w=ADMMWrapper(3,2.0,**kw); w.initialize(np.zeros(3))
    v=w.get_X_step_bias().tolist()
    w.record_X_update(np.ones(3)); w.record_Z_update(np.ones(3)*2)
    r=w.update_dual_var(np.ones(3))
    print(kw, w.mode.value, v, w.get_Z_step_bias().tolist(), round(r,4), w.dual_var.tolist())
    w.retune(4.0); print('   retuned dual',np.round(w.dual_var,6).tolist(),'rho',w.step_size)
    w.load_state(w.state())
b=PartialBarrier(3,2,1,2)
print('ages',b.ages(),'blockers',b.blockers(),'can',b.can_advance(),'first pending',b.first_response_pending())
b.arrive(0,[1.0,2.0],0); b.arrive(2,[3.0,4.0],1)
print('seen',b.seen(),'fresh',b.fresh(),'can',b.can_advance(),'sup',b.superseded(0,0),b.superseded(0,-1))
b.advance(); print('clock',b.clock,'fresh',b.fresh(),'ages',b.ages())
print('state keys',sorted(b.state().keys()))
b2=PartialBarrier(3,2,1,2); b2.load_state(b.state()); print('restored clock',b2.clock,'seen',b2.seen())
d=DenseSolver(PathProvider.from_slots(3,[[(0,),],[(1,)],[(2,)]]))
print(d.solve([0,1],np.array([1.,1.,0.]),np.array([2.,3.]),'route',1,np.zeros(3)))
c=Coordinator(2,3.0,1.25)
print(c.step(np.array([0.5,0.25]),np.array([True,False]),'route'))
c.retune(6.0); print(c.rho, np.round(c.dual,6).tolist(), c.Z.tolist(), c.alpha)
print('SMOKE OK')
PYEOF
